reason: Project lens: record_differs (bank 4, &9FF8-&A02E in the listing) is step 2 renderer code, not PROTECTED, not generated, not raster-timed, no label+offset entries (grep 'record_differs *+' finds none); its one caller (render.6502:446, JSR / BNE stale) reads only Z. The change reorders the same 7 LDA abs,Y / CMP abs,X pairs and 6 BNE out: same 54 bytes, nothing moves, out stays at &A02E, every BNE stays within &A000-&A02E so no page-crossing branch either way. Same RAM read under the same paging: rec_* in bank 4 workspace (&B400-&B7xx, Y = slot+boff < &80, no page cross) and movers_* at &1300-&13ED (X < &22, no cross), main RAM below &3000 so ACCCON's X bit is irrelevant; reads only, no I/O, no writes, no new RAM. Z on exit is clear iff some pair differs regardless of order; A/C/N/V differ but are dead (caller reloads A, C comes from span_in_zone). Front end, helicopter, game over, completion paths go through the same caller with identical semantics, so the game plays the same. Cycle saving depends only on the measured mix (sl differs ~66-71% of calls); recount from the proposer's seed-1 per-call costs 33.6 -> ~25.8 gives ~7.8 cycles per call, close to the claimed 8.5; a pure ordering change cannot be slower by more than a few cycles on the rare type-differs calls.
